# Moraki

> Moraki is a free iPhone app for the people looking after a newborn: one shared notebook for feeds, diapers, sleep and pumping.
> One caregiver logs it and every phone in the household shows it, even offline. Moraki is a notebook, not medical advice.

## Key facts

- **What it is**: A free newborn tracker: one shared baby log for feeds, diapers, sleep and pumping.
- **Who it’s for**: Parents and everyone who looks after a newborn, like a partner, a grandparent or a nanny.
- **Price**: Free
- **Platform**: iPhone. Android is planned.
- **Languages**: English and Greek
- **Where data is stored**: In the European Union
- **Ads**: None
- **Account needed**: No. You sign in only to share with your household.
- **Made by**: C.E. CODE DESIGNS LTD, Cyprus

## Pages in English

- [Home](https://moraki.app/): What Moraki is, how it works, and what you can log.
- [Features](https://moraki.app/features/): Everything Moraki does: logging, history, sharing, night mode, offline use, the doctor report and privacy.
- [Age guides](https://moraki.app/age-guides/): What changes for you in the baby’s first year, stage by stage, and how Moraki can help. Not medical advice.
- [Our story](https://moraki.app/our-story/): Why a dad in Cyprus built Moraki, and its promises: no ads, nothing sold, no account needed, data in the EU.
- [FAQ](https://moraki.app/faq/): Short answers about price, accounts, sharing with your household, privacy, offline use and health questions.
- [Privacy policy](https://moraki.app/privacy/): How Moraki handles your data.
- [Terms of use](https://moraki.app/terms/): The rules for using Moraki.
- [Support](https://moraki.app/support/): Help with common questions, and how to email us.
- [Legal notice](https://moraki.app/legal/): Who runs Moraki: C.E. CODE DESIGNS LTD in Cyprus, its registration and VAT numbers, address, contact, data protection authority and website hosting.
- [Cookie policy](https://moraki.app/cookies/): The website sets no cookies and runs no trackers. It only keeps your light or dark choice in your own browser.
